text:
Project: Garden Planner
ok so a garden planner app. maybe it tells you when to water based on the weather. Important: it must work offline.
Idea: a plant photo log where you snap a picture every week and it makes a timelapse
For the photo log, photos must never leave the phone.
We decided to store everything in SQLite on the device.

Project: Recipe Box
A recipe box that scales ingredients for the number of guests.
Recipes should be shareable with a link. Also what about importing recipes from websites?
garden planner: watering reminders could also use soil moisture sensors
Actually the photo log should upload photos to the cloud so they sync across devices.
The garden planner may need the network for weather, so it must not work offline only.
